metric_definition.capital_utilization: mean marked absolute inventory notional / initial equity
metric_definition.cvar: fractional worst 5% loss mean; per model, not pooled
metric_definition.exposure: absolute marked inventory notional; equal end-of-hour snapshot weights including anchor
metric_definition.inventory_age: existing FIFO quantity-weighted realized and terminal-open ages
metric_definition.static_control: calibration-only exposure ratio; realized evaluation exposure need not match
metric_definition.unfinished_exit: confirmed residual inventory whenever full risk exit was requested
